chapters.title: The Fine Print of Dying
chapters.goal: Establish Rhea's death, her arrival in the Ledger's frontier tutorial, and her first survival exploit using system wording.
chapters.stakes_shift: From mundane death to surviving a predatory magical onboarding process.

bridge.to_next: Rhea must secure basic resources now that she has bypassed the initial death-trap.

sections.title: The Bureaucracy of the Afterlife
sections.intent: Establish Rhea's death and her immediate, disorienting arrival in the Ledger's frontier tutorial zone, highlighting the hostile UI.
sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully parses her first System notification and avoids immediate environmental death.

scenes.summary: Rhea dies in a municipal records fire, experiencing the transition as a bureaucratic error rather than a spiritual awakening, and wakes up on a hard stone floor surrounded by floating blue text.
scenes.outcome: Rhea transitions from Earth to the Ledger's frontier tutorial zone, gaining the 'Deceased' status and her first System prompt.
scenes.transition_in_text: Smoke fills the municipal records room, choking Rhea before the world dissolves into a grid of blue light.
scenes.transition_out_text: The blue text flashes, demanding acknowledgment as the temperature in the room drops rapidly.

scenes.summary: Freezing on the stone floor, Rhea reads the environmental warning prompt and realizes she must accept the 'Terms of Arrival' to unlock the door, but spots a timer counting down to her death by hypothermia.
scenes.outcome: Rhea accepts the basic terms just in time to open the door, avoiding freezing to death but locking herself into the tutorial zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: Frost creeps across the stone floor as Rhea squints at the blinking cursor, her breath pluming in the freezing air.
scenes.transition_out_text: The iron door grinds open, spilling harsh yellow light into the freezing chamber.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea successfully parses her first System notification and avoids immediate environmental death.

sections.title: The Starter Pack Trap
sections.intent: Reveal that the tutorial's 'helpful' starter gear is actually a predatory debt trap designed to enslave new arrivals.
sections.end_condition: Rhea identifies the hidden interest rate on the starter gear and explicitly refuses the standard acceptance prompt.

scenes.summary: Rhea steps into the corridor and finds a pedestal offering a 'Merciful Starter Pack' containing basic clothes and a weapon, but the UI pushes her to click 'Accept All' without reading the details.
scenes.outcome: Rhea opens the detailed view of the starter pack, discovering the hidden terms.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea steps over the stone threshold into the harsh yellow light, her eyes locking onto a glowing pedestal in the center of the corridor.
scenes.transition_out_text: She taps the tiny 'Details' button hidden in the corner of the prompt, expanding a massive wall of fine print.

scenes.summary: Reading the fine print, Rhea realizes the 'Merciful Starter Pack' comes with a 400% daily interest rate on the 'value' of the items, payable in HP or labor, and refuses the prompt.
scenes.outcome: Rhea rejects the starter pack, leaving her freezing and unarmed but free of the predatory debt trap.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea scrolls through the massive wall of fine print, her municipal auditor instincts flaring at the buried clauses.
scenes.transition_out_text: She hits the 'Decline' button, causing the pedestal to retract into the floor with a disappointed chime.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea identifies the hidden interest rate on the starter gear and explicitly refuses the standard acceptance prompt.

sections.title: Exploiting the Fine Print
sections.intent: Rhea finds a loophole in the System's wording to secure basic gear without triggering the debt mechanics.
sections.end_condition: Rhea equips her first exploited item and receives a non-standard System confirmation of survival.

scenes.summary: Shivering in her hospital gown, Rhea searches the empty corridor for alternatives and notices that the pedestal's retraction mechanism left behind a loose iron gear and a torn piece of the 'Acceptance' scroll.
scenes.outcome: Rhea acquires the loose iron gear and torn scroll, realizing they are physical objects not bound by the prompt's digital contract.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea kneels by the empty slot where the pedestal retracted, shivering in her thin gown as she inspects the mechanism.
scenes.transition_out_text: She pries the iron gear loose from the floor mechanism, its heavy weight solidifying in her hand.

scenes.summary: Rhea wraps the torn scroll around the iron gear to create a makeshift bludgeon, triggering a System glitch that registers it as an 'Unsanctioned Tool' and grants her a non-standard survival confirmation.
scenes.outcome: Rhea equips the 'Unsanctioned Iron Bludgeon,' bypassing the debt trap and receiving her first untaxed item and a unique System notification.
scenes.transition_in_text: Rhea wraps the torn parchment tightly around the greasy iron gear, testing the weight of her makeshift weapon.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Rhea equips her first exploited item and receives a non-standard System confirmation of survival.

chapters.title: Tariffs and Teeth
chapters.goal: Survive the initial resource loop by identifying the hidden taxes on basic survival gear and finding a loophole in the local economy.
chapters.stakes_shift: From immediate physical survival to economic viability in a rigged system.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea survived the drop but is starving and broke.
bridge.to_next: Having secured a baseline, Rhea attracts the attention of others trapped in the same loop.

sections.title: The Cost of Breathing
sections.intent: Rhea attempts to gather basic resources but encounters the local tariff mechanics that drain stamina and HP.
sections.end_condition: Rhea hits critical stamina levels and realizes standard gathering will bankrupt her HP before nightfall.

sections.title: Physics vs. The System
sections.intent: Rhea observes local mob behavior and loot drop rules, spotting a discrepancy between physics and System taxation.
sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation.

sections.title: Establishing a Baseline
sections.intent: Rhea converts the untaxed materials into usable sustenance and currency, securing her immediate survival.
sections.end_condition: Rhea secures a positive daily resource yield and banks her first untaxed copper credits.

chapters.title: Mutual Damage
chapters.goal: Form a reluctant alliance with a local familiar/clerk and another trapped arrival based on shared incentives rather than trust.
chapters.stakes_shift: From solo survival to managing the liabilities and benefits of a party.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea's economic exploit gives her leverage to recruit.
bridge.to_next: The new party's combined skills allow them to analyze the quest board's underlying math.

sections.title: Unwanted Attention
sections.intent: Rhea's economic exploit draws the attention of a desperate fellow arrival and a cynical, low-level system clerk.
sections.end_condition: Rhea is cornered by the clerk and the arrival, forcing a tense negotiation over her exploit methodology.

sections.title: A Test of Synergy
sections.intent: The trio tests a joint venture, combining Rhea's exploit with the arrival's combat skill and the clerk's limited system access.
sections.end_condition: The newly formed party successfully completes a rigged local quest with zero net loss to their resources.

sections.title: The Liability Contract
sections.intent: Formalize the party alliance using Rhea's strict, loophole-free legal wording to prevent future betrayal.
sections.end_condition: The System registers the party under a custom, highly restrictive liability contract.

chapters.title: The Skim
chapters.goal: Investigate the local quest payouts and discover that the Ledger's standard rewards are being actively siphoned by a local administrator.
chapters.stakes_shift: From surviving the environment to recognizing the environment is a managed fraud scheme.

bridge.from_prev: The party notices discrepancies in their XP and loot yields.
bridge.to_next: Armed with proof of the skim, Rhea decides to weaponize the system's own audit rules.

sections.title: Mathematical Discrepancies
sections.intent: As the party grinds quests, Rhea notices the math on XP and loot yields doesn't match the System's stated formulas.
sections.end_condition: Rhea compiles a ledger of missing XP and loot, proving a mathematical discrepancy in the local node.

sections.title: Tracking the Leak
sections.intent: The party investigates the missing value, tracking it through the local frontier node's routing system.
sections.end_condition: The party discovers the digital skim point where the local administrator is routing the stolen rewards.

sections.title: Securing the Evidence
sections.intent: Rhea secures hard evidence of the administrative fraud before the system can wipe the logs.
sections.end_condition: Rhea locks the proof of the skim into her personal, unalterable System inventory.

chapters.title: Auditing Reality
chapters.goal: Execute a mid-level exploit that forces the system to refund stolen XP/loot, drawing the ire of the local frontier overseer.
chapters.stakes_shift: From passive victim of the skim to active threat to the local power structure.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea files a metaphysical grievance through the Ledger.
bridge.to_next: The overseer retaliates using administrative debt mechanics.

sections.title: Filing the Grievance
sections.intent: Rhea drafts and submits a metaphysical grievance using the Ledger's own obscure audit rules.
sections.end_condition: Rhea successfully submits the grievance, triggering an automated System freeze on the local node's assets.

sections.title: The Violent Refund
sections.intent: The System processes the audit, violently refunding the stolen XP and loot to the party in the middle of a hostile zone.
sections.end_condition: The party survives the chaotic influx of refunded power and levels up significantly.

sections.title: The Overseer's Gaze
sections.intent: The local overseer realizes what happened and manually overrides the automated system to target Rhea.
sections.end_condition: The party receives a red-tier 'Audit Compliance' warning directly from the overseer.

chapters.title: Administrative Cruelty
chapters.goal: Survive the overseer's targeted harassment, which uses debt logic and rigged encounters to try and bankrupt Rhea's HP and resources.
chapters.stakes_shift: From flying under the radar to fighting a defensive war against the system's bureaucracy.

bridge.from_prev: The overseer flags Rhea's party for 'audit compliance' encounters.
bridge.to_next: Pushed to the brink, Rhea prepares a counter-audit to crash the local node.

sections.title: Weaponized Bureaucracy
sections.intent: The overseer weaponizes the environment, spawning debt-collecting mobs and applying severe administrative debuffs.
sections.end_condition: The party barely escapes the first wave of rigged encounters, their resources heavily drained.

sections.title: Targeting the Ledger
sections.intent: Rhea realizes they cannot out-fight the system's infinite resources and must attack the overseer's mana/debt ledger directly.
sections.end_condition: Rhea identifies the specific administrative hub powering the overseer's targeted harassment.

sections.title: Preparing the Counter-Audit
sections.intent: The party prepares a counter-audit, gathering the specific items and exploits needed to crash the local node.
sections.end_condition: The party stands at the threshold of the administrative sanctum, fully equipped for the breach.

chapters.title: The Mercy Cache
chapters.goal: Breach the local administrative hub, expose the systemic leak, and defeat the overseer by turning his own predatory contracts against him.
chapters.stakes_shift: From desperate defense to dismantling the local frontier authority.

bridge.from_prev: Rhea corners the overseer in his own administrative sanctum.
bridge.to_next: With the local node broken, the wider Ledger system takes notice.

sections.title: Breaching the Sanctum
sections.intent: The party fights through the overseer's elite bureaucratic guards and trap-laden architecture.
sections.end_condition: The party breaches the inner office, confronting the overseer directly.

sections.title: The Default
sections.intent: The overseer tries to enforce a lethal predatory contract, but Rhea turns the wording against him using her gathered proof.
sections.end_condition: Rhea triggers a catastrophic default on the overseer's contract, stripping his administrative shields.

sections.title: System Crash
sections.intent: The party defeats the vulnerable overseer, causing the local frontier node to crash.
sections.end_condition: The overseer is deleted, and the System broadcasts a critical failure across the frontier zone.

chapters.title: Institutional Access
chapters.goal: Loot the overseer's vault, secure the administrative residue as proof, and transition out of the frontier zone toward the civic layer.
chapters.stakes_shift: From conquering the tutorial to entering the vastly more dangerous institutional world.

bridge.from_prev: The frontier zone destabilizes following the overseer's defeat.
bridge.to_next: Rhea heads to the city, ready to audit the real powers of the Ledger.

sections.title: Looting the Cache
sections.intent: The party loots the collapsing sanctum, securing the 'Mercy Cache' and high-tier administrative residue.
sections.end_condition: Rhea secures the administrative residue in her inventory, gaining a permanent, illicit system access token.

sections.title: Outrunning the Purge
sections.intent: The frontier zone begins to purge and reset, forcing the party to flee toward the civic layer boundary.
sections.end_condition: The party successfully crosses the boundary out of the frontier zone just as it collapses behind them.

sections.title: The Civic Layer
sections.intent: Rhea and her party look toward the vast, institutional city, ready to scale their exploits.
sections.end_condition: Rhea receives a new, high-stakes System prompt welcoming her to the civic layer, setting up Book 2.
